source_row.rationale: Daily abdominal girth measurement at a consistent landmark helps track changes in ascites fluid accumulation over time, providing an objective measure to monitor treatment response, typically used alongside (not as a replacement for) daily weight monitoring for comprehensive fluid status assessment.
source_row.source_detail: Purpose of Daily Abdominal Girth Measurement
source_row.stem: A nurse measures a client's abdominal girth daily at the same location, using a consistent landmark. This measurement helps:
